source: Current JRA-VAN Data Lab SDK/developer documentation plus JV-Data 4.9.0.1 field specification

current_sdk.preferred_runtime: Current official 64-bit SDK + Python 3.14 + pywin32 when installed on the local Windows PC
current_sdk.legacy_32bit_note: 32-bit SDK remains available, but x86 is no longer a universal requirement after SDK 5.0.0. Match Python/process bitness to the JV-Link installation actually used.

0B11.name: 速報馬体重
0B11.timing: around 1 hour before post; realtime availability is short-lived

0B14.name: 速報開催情報 一括
0B14.update_behavior: retrieve current change information for the meeting day; changes/withdrawals must not be silently carried forward as current truth

retrieval.bulk_change_info: JVRTOpen('0B14', YYYYMMDD), then repeatedly read records until EOF.
retrieval.event_mode: Official Python 3.14 guide demonstrates DispatchWithEvents + JVWatchEvent; events include jockey/weather/course/avoid/time/weight. Event handler can call JVRTOpen for the event's dataspec/key.
retrieval.official_python_read_path: The 2026 Python guide uses JVGets with bytearray buffer, converts returned memoryview bytes from cp932, and JVClose after each realtime read session.
retrieval.platform_constraint: Local Windows execution with an installed JV-Link is required. Current SDK 5.0.0 provides both 64-bit and 32-bit JV-Link.

gate_implication.important: The previous final-state JVD file remains forbidden for current-race features. Official realtime feeds are a separate source class and may unlock current features only after a real capture is hashed and both announcement/source time and acquisition time are proven <= the prediction snapshot.
gate_implication.historical_limitation: Official FAQ states realtime data is available for about one week. This does not retroactively repair historical DEV provenance; forward capture is required.
